TITLE.LOCALISED_TEXT: 迷（めい）路（ろ）の終（お）わり

ACTIVATED_ABILITY.LOCALISED_TEXT: {3}, {T}, Return Maze’s End to its owner’s hand: Search your library for a Gate card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle your library. If you control ten or more Gates with different names, you win the game.

{3}, {T}, renvoyez la Fin du labyrinthe dans la main de son propriétaire : Cherchez dans votre bibliothèque une carte de porte, mettez-la sur le champ de bataille, puis mélangez votre bibliothèque. Si vous contrôlez au moins dix cartes de porte ayant des noms différents, vous gagnez la partie.

{3}, {T}, regresar el Final del laberinto a la mano de su propietario: Busca en tu biblioteca una carta de Portal, ponla en el campo de batalla y luego baraja tu biblioteca. Si controlas diez o más Portales con distintos nombres, ganas el juego.

{3}, {T}, bringe das Ende des Labyrinths auf die Hand seines Besitzers zurück: Durchsuche deine Bibliothek nach einer Tor-Karte, bringe sie ins Spiel und mische dann deine Bibliothek. Falls du zehn oder mehr Tore mit unterschiedlichen Namen kontrollierst, gewinnst du die Partie.

{3}, {T}, Fai tornare la Fine del Labirinto in mano al suo proprietario: Passa in rassegna il tuo grimorio per una carta Cancello, mettila sul campo di battaglia, poi rimescola il tuo grimorio. Se controlli dieci o più Cancelli con nomi diversi, vinci la partita.
{3}, {T}, 迷路の終わりをオーナーの手札に戻す：あなたのライブラリーから門カードを１枚探し、それを戦場に出す。その後あなたのライブラリーを切り直す。あなたが異なる名前の門を10個以上コントロールしているなら、あなたはこのゲームに勝利する。
{3}, {T}, 미로의 끝을 소유자의 손으로 되돌린다: 당신의 서고에서 관문 카드 한 장을 찾은 다음 전장에 놓고 당신의 서고를 섞는다. 당신이 이름이 다른 관문을 열 개 이상 조종한다면 게임에서 승리한다.

{3}, {T}, верните Конец Лабиринта в руку его владельца: найдите в вашей библиотеке карту Врат, положите ее на поле битвы, затем перетасуйте вашу библиотеку. Если вы контролируете десять или более Врат с разными именами, вы выигрываете партию.

{3}, {T}, Devolva Fim do Labirinto para a mão de seu dono: Procure um card de Portão em seu grimório, coloque-o no campo de batalha e, depois, embaralhe o seu grimório. Se você controlar dez ou mais Portões de nomes diferentes, você ganha o jogo.
{3}，{T}，将迷宫终点移回其拥有者手上：从你的牌库中搜寻一张门牌，将之放进战场，然后将你的牌库洗牌。如果你操控十个或更多名称各不相同的门，你便赢得这盘游戏。
{3}，{T}，將迷宮終點移回其擁有者手上：從你的牌庫中搜尋一張門牌，將之放進戰場，然後將你的牌庫洗牌。如果你操控十個或更多名稱各不相同的門，你便贏得這盤遊戲。
ACTIVATED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION:
local filter = ClearFilter() local effectController = EffectController() filter:Add( FE_SUBTYPE, OP_IS, LAND_TYPE_GATE ) filter:SetZone( ZONE_LIBRARY, effectController ) effectController:SetItemCount( 1 ) for i = 0, (1-1) do effectController:SetItemPrompt(i, "CARD_QUERY_CHOOSE_A_GATE_TO_PUT_ONTO_THE_BATTLEFIELD" ) end
effectController:ChooseItems( EffectDC():Make_Targets(0) )
local targetDC = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0) if targetDC ~= nil then local target = targetDC:Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then target:PutOntoBattlefield( EffectController() ) end end

local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add(FE_SUBTYPE, OP_IS, LAND_TYPE_GATE) filter:Add(FE_CONTROLLER, OP_IS, EffectController()) local numGates = filter:EvaluateObjects() -- we have now worked out all of the gates that we have, time to iterate over them and see what names we have if numGates >= 10 then local mazeDC = EffectDC():Make_Chest(0) -- need to loop over all the gates we have for i = 0, (numGates-1) do local currentGate = filter:GetNthEvaluatedObject(i)
if currentGate ~= nil then local currentGateName = currentGate:GetCardName()
local numStoredGates = mazeDC:Count()
-- no we need to compare the gate we have with all of the currently stored gates if numStoredGates == 0 then mazeDC:Set_CardPtr(numStoredGates, currentGate) else for j = 0, (numStoredGates-1) do local cardToCheck = mazeDC:Get_CardPtr(j)
if cardToCheck ~= nil then local currentName = cardToCheck:GetCardName() if currentGateName == currentName then -- if we have a match we should break break end if j == (numStoredGates-1) then -- this is the last time the loop will run and the have not hit a match yet so time to store the land for further iterations mazeDC:Set_CardPtr(numStoredGates, currentGate) end end end end end end if mazeDC:Count() >= 10 then -- if we have 10 differently named gates then we win! EffectController():WinGame(EffectSourceLKI()) end end
